prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one detailed realistic wide landscape video game environment concept, clean photographic rendering.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is the authoritative site layout, every footprint, river and connection stays in place. Images 2 and 3 are ONLY architectural/material/security design references: pristine white panels, black glass framing, restrained warm lights, sparse red access indicators, friendly loop emblem without text. Ignore all earlier rear-campus images. Render another camera within the EXACT campus of image 1, not a redesigned campus.
For orientation, top of the plan is north/front/city; bottom south/rear/mountain; right east. Headquarters is the long horizontal building near north edge, central rear gardens and separate rectangular labs south of it. Internal rocky river runs west-east across lower middle, curves northeast into the Y junction beyond east wall. Four grated low bridges cross it at the positions shown. More separate labs on its south bank. Keep footprints, distances and recognizable landmarks. City and road lie beyond the separate front river north of headquarters.
Architecture elevations take the sleek white/black look from images 2/3, scaled to the plan. Sleek computational and robotics labs, roof access, modest grass roofs and native California planting. Natural flowing river visibly continuous, no reflecting pools, no greenhouse. Truly late NIGHT: dark blue-black sky, shadowed gardens, localized warm lamps, readable materials and routes, most offices dark. Sparse security: at most one ordinary white-shirt guard with sporty AR glasses and cable to belt puck, and one white/black compact mechanical quadruped robot dog. No crowds, no biological dogs, no humanoid robots, no words or captions. Wet paving, clinical technological paradise with sheltered shadow routes. No montage.

CAMERA 1: from the central rear terrace of headquarters (plan position x29%, y35%), looking SOUTH into the park, slightly elevated balcony view. Headquarters wall/black glazing crops the right foreground as camera looks rearward. Central labs frame the garden paths ahead. The internal river lies beyond these labs, across the middle distance, with the center grated crossing at x40%,y63% leading to south-bank labs on the rising rocky slope. East is camera-left. Show lab roofs and courtyard connections in the exact plan arrangement. City and front entrance river are BEHIND the camera and must not appear. Wide 28mm architectural composition, no huge newly invented tower. UPDATED MASTER PLAN overrides previous plan. Preserve its new elevated enclosed hallways: front headquarters EAST wing connects southeast to adjacent east lab; central north-bank labs have an east-west elevated glass corridor; south-bank center lab connects EAST to square green-roof lab by elevated glass corridor. All corridors black-framed glazing with white fascia, slim diagonal structural braces, warm interior light exactly like front architecture reference. Maintain open ground passage below and exterior stairs to roof terraces. River crossings remain separate LOW METAL GRATING bridges. Do not turn river bridges into glass corridors. Preserve building count, footprints and river.

overheadPrompt: Edit image 1, the overhead campus plan. Preserve its camera, entire river topology, roads, entrance bridge, building footprints, night lighting and landscape. Images 2 and 3 establish the architectural design of enclosed elevated connecting hallways: slender black-framed glazed rectangular corridors with white fascia, warm interior light and visible diagonal structural braces. Add exactly THREE elevated enclosed pedestrian skybridges without relocating any buildings: (A) front connector from the EAST/right wing of long headquarters to the adjacent rectangular lab immediately southeast at plan x49%, y40%, crossing their access lane; (B) rear/north-bank connector from central lab x39%,y49% to east lab x48%,y51%, over the garden path; (C) south-bank connector between lab x39%,y76% and square green-roof lab x51%,y76%, crossing their courtyard. Show flat narrow corridor roofs from above, with visible support/landing geometry appropriate to overhead camera. A matches the front reference hallway. Keep all four low grated RIVER bridges separate and untouched: skybridges connect BUILDINGS only, never replace river bridges. Add readable exterior stairs from these connected buildings to roof terraces for vertical exploration. No new towers, no greenhouse, no text or labels. Keep everything else unchanged. This updated overhead is the master layout for subsequent images.
